description: A vector phaseshaping oscillator with a display you read the two waveshaping points off, an ADSR envelope and a multimode filter, all polyphonic

params.text: Sets the oscillator's pitch, sweeping about eight and a half octaves from end to end
Sets the V value of the red pair, 0 to 4, which moves the red point up and down the display
Sets the V value of the blue pair, 0 to 4, which moves the blue point up and down the display
Sets the D value of the red pair, 0.5 at the counter-clockwise end falling to 0 at the clockwise end, which moves the red point across the display
Sets the D value of the blue pair, 0.5 at the counter-clockwise end falling to 0 at the clockwise end, which moves the blue point across the display
Sets how far the voltage at the FM input moves the pitch
Trims the pitch finely either side of where the PITCH knob is set
Drops the pitch by two octaves, by one octave, or not at all
Sets how much of the envelope is added to the red pair's D value
Sets how much of the envelope is added to the blue pair's D value
Sets how much of the envelope is added to the red pair's V value
Sets how much of the envelope is added to the blue pair's V value
Attenuates the voltage at the red pair's D input before it is added to that knob
Attenuates the voltage at the blue pair's D input before it is added to that knob
Attenuates the voltage at the red pair's V input before it is added to that knob
Attenuates the voltage at the blue pair's V input before it is added to that knob
Sets the time the envelope takes to rise to full after the gate opens
Sets the time the envelope takes to fall from full to the sustain level
Sets the level the envelope holds at while the gate stays open
Sets the time the envelope takes to fall to silence after the gate closes
Switches the envelope into its long mode, and lights while that mode is on
Sets the filter cutoff, which starts fully open at the clockwise end
Sets the filter resonance, from none at the counter-clockwise end up to 99% at the clockwise end
Attenuates the voltage at the CUT input before it is added to the filter cutoff
Sets how much of the envelope is added to the filter cutoff
Switches the filter between high pass, band pass and low pass
Switches what the display draws for the blue pair, and lights while the second of the two views is showing
Switches what the display draws for the red pair, and lights while the second of the two views is showing
Switches what the display draws for the filter, and lights while the second of the two views is showing
Switches frequency modulation between exponential and linear, and lights while linear is chosen

inputs.text: Sets the pitch at one volt per octave, added to the PITCH, TUNE and OCT settings, and read separately for each polyphony channel
Moves the red pair's V value, scaled by that pair's V attenuator
Moves the blue pair's V value, scaled by that pair's V attenuator
Modulates the pitch, scaled by the FM knob and read as an exponential or a linear amount according to the LIN button
Moves the red pair's D value, scaled by that pair's D attenuator
Moves the blue pair's D value, scaled by that pair's D attenuator
The gate that opens and closes the envelope, reading high above 0.5V; the number of channels here is the number of voices the module runs
Moves the filter cutoff, scaled by the filter's CV attenuator
Moves the red pair's D value with no attenuator in the way, added on top of everything else that sets it
Moves the blue pair's D value with no attenuator in the way, added on top of everything else that sets it
Moves the red pair's V value with no attenuator in the way, 0.8 per volt, so 5V covers the whole of that knob's travel
Moves the blue pair's V value with no attenuator in the way, 0.8 per volt, so 5V covers the whole of that knob's travel

outputs.text: The audio output, one channel for each channel at the gate input

notes: nothing sounds until a gate is patched to GATE; the module counts its voices from the number of channels on that jack, and with nothing there it runs none at all
the V and D values are clamped after everything is added: V between 0 and 4, D between 0 and 0.5
menu: Model 2 (softer sound and V modulation):  — switches the oscillator to the maker's second model
High Quality — runs the oscillator at a higher internal quality
